styleRecipes.summary: Swiss data poster: cream #F7F3EC paper with a faint 90 px print grid and a pink/black spine bleeding off the left edge; black #111 type and 3–6 px rules, one hot-pink #F472B6 accent used as fills (with black text) for the subject and the answer. Montserrat 900 headlines, Montserrat 600–800 copy, IBM Plex Mono 700 figures. Head-to-head: two stacked white A/B cards with identical hatched empty tracks; at the reveal both bars grow together from one labelled zero line on one linear scale (axis 0 → nice round max), values count up to the exact text, winner turns pink with a check. Missing-slot: an ordinal ladder (equal rungs, “rank order · not to scale”) of two anchors with three dashed A/B/C insertion gaps; the pink target card drops into its gap on the downbeat, then values count up and thin bars grow from the ladder’s left edge, which becomes a labelled zero line. Ease-out entries ≤ 0.5 s, no camera moves, calm think window, source line always visible.

Field notebook on a graph-paper desk: paper #FAFAF9, charcoal #18181B ink, teal #14B8A6 accent, thermal green #22C55E / orange #F97316. ' +
    'Fraunces 900 headlines and clue text, Geist Mono labels and numbers. Sharp-cornered white index cards (3 px ink border, hard 8 px offset shadow, ' +
    'orange header rule, teal number tab) are dealt in from off-frame with a decelerating slide-and-settle; a tally card counts the countries that still fit ' +
    '(195 → … → 1) on an honest zero-based bar. Reveal = a speckled green rubber stamp slammed onto the pile, then a ruled locator card ' +
    '(orthographic, answer in teal, neighbours paper with ink outlines). Candidate checklists tick/cross per clue with thermal green/orange marks.

Low-poly ocean: deep navy #0B1F33 full-frame depth gradient with a faint static triangular facet mesh; maps sit in a rounded '
    + 'card of lighter shallow-water navy. Neighbors are muted sand #E8D5B0, other land is dim slate #4A5966 and unlabelled, the answer is '
    + 'warm orange #F2A154 with a subtle low-poly facet overlay. Nunito 900 for the question, 800 for map labels (white with navy halo). '
    + 'Canonical globe rings in one orthographic projection centred on the target, cropped to the generator window. Neighbors drift in '
    + 'radially (0.5 s ease-out); the gap is a dashed white outline pulsing softly; before the reveal a shadow gathers, then the answer piece '
    + 'drops in with a spring and a soft drop shadow, the label pops, and the camera pulls back (span ×2.2, same centre, ease-in-out).

Almanac: parchment #F4ECD8 with a soft vignette, laid-paper lines and a double-rule page frame; sepia ink #2B1D0E; '
    + 'highlighter yellow #EAB308 as fill only, deep ochre #A16207 for accent text. Fraunces italic 900 headlines, Geist Mono for '
    + 'years and labels. Typographic event card (double rule, vector fleurons, no photos). A horizontal ruler timeline pans in '
    + 'unlabelled, then carries the A/B/C year marks (or the pinned anchor). Calm ease-out entries; anticipation wind-up; the '
    + 'reveal is a year odometer rolling to the answer (or the “?” token gliding onto its side of the anchor at an honest distance), followed by a single '
    + 'pan/zoom of the ruler and a yellow highlight on the correct mark.
